I went to Bandon International Hospital 14/02. Due to a small cat bite. The need was there thus to get a Rabies vaccine. I showed the doctor the latest edition which I had on picture of my vaccinations. I informed him that this was not the fully latest edition of my vaccination and therefore that I will not be taking a Tetanus shot. Due to having the preference to actually know which ones I already took and based apon it decide when the correct timeline is reached.
I informed this aswell after to the 2 desk personnel which is in hearing distance aswell from the room where the doctor and where the nurse was.
After which that when I was receiving my vaccine which was a tray with two siringes. After the first one I asked which one is the one which she, the nurse, is about to do. It was the Tetanus shot which after 3 people , 75% of the staff was informed that I was not to be taking a Tetanus shot , still it being attempted to be applied. Eventhough I am happy about the application of the Rabies shot, it can not be that when 75% of your personel present is aware that no tetanus shot should be applied, that you then still try to apply it.
What if she started with the Tetanus shot. I could have given a lower score. I will leave it at 4/5.

I came in here a few days after a motorbike accident and had a great experience. I only had a couple of scratches but wanted to make sure they would not be infected. I had no wait and was seen immediately. The doctor, she was great, same with her staff, they cleaned my wounds and talked me through every step, prescribed me antibiotics and asked that I came in for two more cleanings to make sure everything was working and going well. I felt well cared for and no longer scared, I am traveling alone so when the accident happened I didn’t know where to go or what to do. I did not feel overcharged, only well cared for. Thank you to the doctor and her staff!

I had a very positive experience here.
The staff is very friendly and they work fast.
Their English is above average and their services include transport to and from the hospital and the pickup of samples.
The facility is very clean.
